description: @types/node follows the oldest supported Node major, the lower bound of engines.node.
Move allowedVersions with engines.node in package.json and packages/cli/package.json and the catalog range in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Runner image majors (ubuntu-24.04 to ubuntu-26.04) are a separate decision, not a weekly update.
The github-actions manager extracts runners under the github-runners datasource; there is no github-runners manager to match.
Renovate tags every catalog entry pnpm.catalog.default, so the runtime group names the third-party dependencies the published spur-board package installs or inlines.
fix(deps) releases them. scripts/renovate.test.ts checks this list against the shipped closure. Keep this rule last so it wins over the dev group and the chore type.
